name: City Council Special Community Meeting - Meetup with the Mayor
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL OF MONTEREY PARK
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  NOTICE OF CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING

As a quorum of the City Council may be present for the event, this special meeting notice is being
issued for the purpose of the Brown Act pursuant to Government Code Section 54956. 1 Members
of the City Council present will not formally convene as a body, nor will they take any formal action
at the event.

General Information
Documents related to an Agenda item are available to the public in the City Clerk’s Office located
at 320 West Newmark Avenue, Monterey Park, CA 91754, during normal business hours.
Visit www.montereypark.ca.gov/agendas for agenda documents, policies, procedures, and
instructions for remote participation.

Special Accommodation
Per the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this
meeting, please email City Hall at mpclerk@montereypark.ca.gov or call (626) 307-1359 for
reasonable accommodation at least 8 hours before a meeting. Council Chambers are wheelchair
accessible.

Public Participation

  • In Person – Complete a guest’s speaker card and submit it to the City Clerk. When
  called upon, approach the podium.
  • Zoom – https://us06web.zoom.us/j/83333642600, Meeting ID: 833 3364 2600
  To join the speaking queue, use the “raise hand” feature if using a device. Speakers
  will be unmuted and called on to speak.
  • Telephone – Dial 1(669) 444-9171 or 1(253) 205-0468, enter Meeting ID: 833 3364
  2600 and press #. To join the speaking queue, press *9 to raise hand and press *6 to
  unmute when called on to speak.
  • Written Public Comment – Accepted up to 3 hours before the meeting by completing
  an online form at www.montereypark.ca.gov/writtencomm. Written communications
  are provided to the City Council and filed as part of the City’s administrative record but
  not read during the council meeting.

1 This agenda is being posted in an abundance of caution in accordance with ___ Ops.Cal.Atty.Gen. ___

(April 18, 2024) [Opn. No. 23-102 at 2024 WL 1812958].
   Monterey Park City Council Community Meeting Agenda, September 30, 2026 - Page 2

Addressing the Council
Pursuant to Government Code § 54954.3(a), members of the public may address the City Council
only on matters listed on this Agenda. No other public comment will be accepted. Pursuant to
Rule 4 of Resolution No. 2026-R23, the speaker time limits will be determined based on the
number of speakers requesting to speak. If desirable, the Mayor and City Council may change
the time limits.

Standard of Decorum
Any person addressing the Council who disrupts, disturbs, impedes, or otherwise renders
infeasible the meeting’s orderly conduct, who, after a request by the presiding officer, refuses to
cease such behavior may be removed from the City Council chambers or remote participation
platform.

Live Translation
Meeting may be translated (transcribed or audio) to the language selected. Availability may vary
by language and technology platform.

  • Wordly*– Visit https://attend.wordly.ai/join/ERPR-7201, click on the arrow to select
  language and then click Attend. Use captions on your device or listen with a headset.
  • Zoom* – Utilize the Closed Captions feature for audio and visual translation of your desire
  language.

即時翻譯
會議內容可翻譯（轉錄或音訊）至您選擇的語言。具體可用性可能因語言和技術平台而異。

  • Wordly* – 造訪 https://attend.wordly.ai/join/ERPR-7201，點擊箭頭選擇語言，
  然後點擊「參加」。您可以使用裝置上的字幕或使用耳機收聽。
  • Zoom* – 使用「隱藏式字幕」功能，即可獲得您所需語言的音訊和視訊翻譯。

Traducción en vivo
La reunión puede traducirse (mediante transcripción o audio) al idioma seleccionado. La
disponibilidad puede variar según el idioma y la plataforma tecnológica.

  • Wordly* – Visite https://attend.wordly.ai/join/ERPR-7201, haga clic en la flecha para
  seleccionar el idioma y luego haga clic en "Attend" (Participar). Utilice los subtítulos en su
  dispositivo o escuche a través de auriculares.
  • Zoom* – Utilice la función de subtítulos (Closed Captions) para obtener la traducción en
  audio y visual del idioma que desee.
 Monterey Park City Council Community Meeting Agenda, September 30, 2026 - Page 3

  MEETUP WITH THE MAYOR

  Asayoru Maid Cafe
  500 N. Atlantic Blvd. Unit 125, Monterey Park 91754

  Wednesday
  September 30, 2026
  5:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  III.  Adjournment
